Good. Slabs are half-height blocks. The polished granite slabs at y=0 are bottom slabs (occupying the lower half of the block space). The grindstone at y=1 is placed in the block space ABOVE the slab. Since the slab only occupies the lower half of y=0, the grindstone at y=1 is a separate block space entirely — this is valid placement. The grindstone can be placed on top of a bottom slab via `/setblock`.
